items.label: R. GHOSTBUSTERS+
items.why: The packed boot PRG contains the OUG intro and trainer in front of the resident engine. Control reaches the resident round setup at $0908 after the trainer.
Three zero-block USR directory separators share the same chain. Their hyphens separate the directory entries.

items.label: LEVELA
items.why: The KERNAL LOAD return at $5613 matched the complete disk payload at $6000. The first unpacker at $5619 and the run-length pass called from $32FF expanded it into this part.
